discounts.name: COMBINA 1 (NOS + Continente + Galp)
discounts.conditions: Requires NOS + Continente + Galp COMBINA subscription, tier 1. Applied automatically via Cartão Continente / Mundo Galp apps. Max 60 L per fill and 250 L per month.

discounts.name: COMBINA 2 (NOS + Continente + Galp)
discounts.conditions: COMBINA tier 2. Max 60 L per fill and 250 L per month.

discounts.name: COMBINA 3 (NOS + Continente + Galp)
discounts.conditions: COMBINA tier 3. Max 60 L per fill and 250 L per month.

discounts.name: Cartão Continente + Mundo Galp coupon
discounts.conditions: Coupon earned with a Continente purchase of 30 € or more; credited as Cartão Continente balance. Link Cartão Continente to Mundo Galp. Assumed not to stack with COMBINA.

discounts.name: Mundo Galp app
discounts.conditions: Free Mundo Galp app, with a discount from 5 c/L (the published minimum). Assumed not to stack with COMBINA or Continente coupons.

discounts.name: Galp + Continente summer campaign
discounts.conditions: 15 c/L in Cartão Continente (weekend purchase coupon) + 10 c/L in Mundo Galp. Mainland only.

discounts.name: Lidl Plus + My Repsol
discounts.conditions: Link Lidl Plus to the My Repsol app: 6 c/L instant + 4 c/L My Repsol balance (Lidl Plus app alone gives only the 6 c/L instant). Also a 3 € Lidl Plus coupon per 30 € of fuel, not counted here. Repsol partner discounts generally don't stack with each other.

discounts.name: My Repsol Plano Motor (free)
discounts.conditions: Free My Repsol registration. Repsol's page lists 8 c/L on fuel but also advertises up to 10 c/L; the lower figure is used here. Balance is subject to daily and monthly limits.

discounts.name: Sporting / Benfica / FC Porto member
discounts.conditions: Club membership card linked to the Mais Repsol app.

discounts.name: Professional orders (Contabilistas, Economistas, Enfermeiros, Psicólogos…)
discounts.conditions: Members of partner professional orders with a Mais Repsol account. Some orders get 5 + 5 c/L instead.

discounts.name: SC Braga / Marítimo / Casa Pia member, Olympic athletes
discounts.conditions: With the My Repsol app and partner card: 6 c/L instant + 4 c/L balance. Physical card only: 5 c/L instant on regular fuels, 6 c/L on Neotech, Autogás and AdBlue. Terms read on the SC Braga page and assumed the same for the other partners listed.

discounts.name: Belenenses member / Betano customer
discounts.conditions: 5 c/L immediate (or 5 c/L balance).

discounts.name: ACP member
discounts.conditions: 6 c/L on regular fuels on weekdays; 10 c/L on all fuels at weekends; 15 c/L on Ultimate on the 15th of each month.

discounts.name: Pay with MB WAY (2% cashback)
discounts.conditions: 2% back on all BP fuels when paying 30 € or more with MB WAY at participating stations. Requires MB WAY UP!; scratch the voucher in the app to credit the UP! balance.

discounts.name: Pingo Doce Poupa Mais fuel balance
discounts.conditions: Since 2 Nov 2026: 3 € BP fuel balance per 30 € spent at Pingo Doce. Set the value to the balance you typically earn per month; it is spread over your litres per month. Minimum 16 L per fill. Maximum use per fill depends on litres: 2 € (16–19 L), 4 € (20–24 L), then 1 € more per 5 L up to 12 € (60–100 L). Redeeming also earns 1–6 € of Pingo Doce store balance, not counted here. Doesn't stack with Bónus or Routex cards.

discounts.name: Via Verde balance
discounts.conditions: 1 € Via Verde balance per 20 litres of regular fuel (2 € on Ultimate). Needs a BP Premierplus / Poupa Mais card linked to Via Verde and a paid Via Verde Mobilidade or Mobilidade Leve plan (Mobilidade: 1,99 €/month, not deducted here).

discounts.name: Moeve (ex-Cepsa) free card
discounts.conditions: Free Moeve card, direct discount at the pump.

discounts.name: DECO PROteste Descontos card
discounts.conditions: For DECO PROteste subscribers, with the card registered in Clube Moeve gow. Regular fuel: 7 c/L direct + 5 c/L balance (Óptima: 7 + 6). Stations may add up to 7 c/L direct, for up to 20 c/L in total; not counted here.

discounts.name: Intermarché campaign: 10 € on fills ≥ 50 €
discounts.conditions: Occasional campaign days only (e.g. first Wednesday of the month). Credited to Cartão Poupança, spent at Intermarché stores. Excludes 24h/pre-pay pumps.

discounts.name: Clube Auchan campaign: 20 c/L as store balance
discounts.conditions: Occasional campaign days only (last seen 23–24 Oct 2026). Credited to Clube Auchan card, spent in Auchan stores, not at the pump.
